value.rationale: The natural necklace/Witt polynomial and irreducible-polynomial count has a complete previously unidentified exact two-adic residue-fiber law for all odd squarefree lengths and all precision levels, contrasting known parity-only results. The support is the even ideal while mass is nonuniform on a single deeper ideal and depends only on \(\nu_2(\varphi(n))\); the sharp nonsquarefree boundary prevents an arbitrary index slice. This exact frequency datum is meaningful for congruence questions as alphabet sizes vary, without unsupported claims about prime-power inputs.
